content.text: Rolae pingi dupwa
Kamongome mende pyakapya dokona lao pii ketae palyuo lao rae maiyuo karalapape.
Banya pii warombo singi dupwa peparae nakama banya kingi lakandalapape.
Kurulu rambyalu gitape dupwame
Anatu dokona ange lao kingi lakando karalapape.
Banya lao kenane enenge pyao dokopa
rambyalu gitape dupwa mora mora piso pyao pii ketae palyuo lao rae maiyuo karalapape.
Kamongona yulu dupwa angingyuo pao
banyapii dupwa kinyi ingyuo silyamo.
Kamongome rolaena renge dokona mona retelyamopa
banya mona retenge ota nange dokome yuu muu peparaena silyamo.
Yake doko Kamongo baame sinya lao lao wasiya.
Neta kana buipi banya piimi sipureya.
Baame kota pete doko muupyuo yuu mendakisa sinya leya.
Baame kota peteme lumu doko minyuo neta epa nana lao mapi pyao kata roko reteya.
Isa wambu peparaeme Kamongo pakalapape.
Yuu muu rae lao palyuo pelene wambu peparaeme baa mupwa lao suu pyao pakale lao karalapape.
Baame pii leyamo dokopayuu muu peparae ingiya.
Dopa pyuo pena leyamopa bange peparae epo maro leya.
Kamongome yuu liti andake dupwana yulu piramili dupwa kata rokonge.
Pirama lao lao rapa rapa pingi dupwa pao kata roko minyilyasa pyuo pee laa nange.
Dopa pipala baa range pinya lenge dupwa waiya lao mee ingyuo paa napala
kulisa ingyuo soo penge.
Yuu liti andake mende Anatu Kamongo ingyuo pelyamo lao suu pilyaminyi dupwa rae maiyuo parami.
Wambu baa rangena lao rombo palyuo nyiya ingilyamo dupwa rae maiyuo parami.
Kamongome yake dorena karo kandano kandapyamo dokopa
wambu peparae kando karamo.
Banya iso karenge yuu dokona karo
isa yuunya wambu palaminyi dupwa kandano kandelyamo.
Baame nakamana suu pingi dupwa maiyuo
dee dopande pilinilyamo lao soo karamo.
Kiŋi yanda singi malu karaminyipape nakamana porai dokome yandana pyao anamasi minyara ingya nange.
Yanda singi mendeme banya porainya renge dokome anamasi minya nange.
Yanda pela penge mena ose dupwa wua rombasi ingyuo paramosa kapa pyuo wini laa narami.
Nakamana porai renge dokome angi mende pii nara.
Kamongona mona reto karalu karenge dokona baa keta pyamalyuo banya pii warombo soo karenge dupwa
baame kandokondali pyuo kandaro karenge.
Baame kumarami dokona kyawa minyuo karo
lopo singi dokopa reto karo pingi.
Namwa Kamongo keta pyamalyapala karamano lao sepala kararama.
Baame namwa nyiso kingi kapeme nee pyuo minyuo papingi.
Baa karamo dokona lao namwa rae maipala
banyakingi poo pyasi doko angingyuo minyilyamano.
Emba keta mende pira lao mona kare kare karamano.
Dokona embena mona retenge renge doko namwa keta palyako puu pena.
